title: 第15章 许明姝与许明仙周二求追读第16章 五年后周二求追读
content_zh:
;;
时光荏苒。
一晃就来到了岁祭。
许川也到了三十而立的年纪。
第二日，巳时一刻。
白静肚子莫名疼痛，再次临盆。
“大龙，富贵去请稳婆来。”
许川早已约好了稳婆，让她这几日空出时间来。
两人嫌稳婆走路慢，直接架着她飞快赶往许家，惊得她心慌慌，脸色都有些发白。
然后————
努力、挣扎、嘶喊。
两三个时辰后，顺利产子。
此次诞下了一对龙凤胎。
女娃先出，叫许明姝，许川取了个小名，雪霁。
男娃叫许明仙，小名云奴。
岁月如梭。
一眨眼就来到了两小儿的满月宴。
白家亲友，陈伯他们都来庆贺。
直至酒足饭饱后离去。
许川走入堂屋，取二人指尖之血入族谱。

【许明姝：许家二代】
【灵根：五行不全，无修仙资质】
【天赋：无】
【血脉：无】
【注：灵魂力量是正常人的两倍，天生灵觉敏锐】
“灵魂力量是正常人的两倍，天生灵觉敏锐，看来小雪霁是天赋异禀呢。”
“或许她适合【万灵低语】，未来可以做到驯养猛兽。”
接着，许川看向许明仙的信息。
【许明仙：许家二代】
【灵根：五行俱全，可修行，杂灵根资质】
【天赋：气吞山河】
【血脉：无】
【注：修行之人皆是五行俱全，资质分为伪灵根，杂灵根，真灵根，地灵根与天灵根，主要按照灵根纯度划分。
气吞山河：引气入体，恢复法力的速度将是其他人的数成，发挥至极致，可达数倍，真正具有气吞山河之势】
“修仙天赋！”
许川脸上露出狂喜之色。
许家终于出了一个具有修仙天赋的人。
这意味着，二代开始就有望接触修仙者的世界。
与此同时，许川脑海里陡然涌入大量的内容，汇总到一起竟然是一本由凡入仙的典籍。
名为《先天五行造化功》。

这是许家诞生第一个修仙天赋的后代，族谱赐下的功法。
武道先天境界方可修炼。
可补五行之残缺，提纯灵根，最终达到真灵根的层次。
content_en:
;;
Time flies.
In a blink of an eye, we arrived at the New Year Festival.
Xu Chuan has also reached the age of thirty.
On the second day, it was a quarter of an hour.
Bai Jing had inexplicable stomach pain and went into labor again.
"Dalong, Fugui, please go and invite Po Wen."
Xu Chuan had already made an appointment with Po Wen and asked her to make time in the past few days.
The two of them thought Wenpo was walking slowly, so they rushed her to Xu's house directly, which made her panic and turn a little pale.
Then————
Try, struggle, scream.
Two or three hours later, the baby was delivered successfully.
This time a pair of twins, a boy and a girl, were born.
The baby girl came out first, named Xu Mingshu, and Xu Chuan gave her a nickname, Xue Ji.
The boy's name is Xu Mingxian, nicknamed Yunnu.
Time flies.
In the blink of an eye, the full moon party for the two children arrived.
Relatives and friends of the Bai family, including Uncle Chen, all came to celebrate.
He left after having enough wine and food.
Xu Chuan walked into the main room and took the blood from their fingertips to enter the family tree.
[Xu Mingshu: The second generation of the Xu family]
[Spiritual Root: Incomplete Five Elements, No Qualification for Immortal Cultivation]
[Talent: None]
[Bloodline: None]
[Note: Soul power is twice that of normal people, and they are born with keen spiritual awareness]
"The soul power is twice that of a normal person, and he is born with a keen spiritual sense. It seems that Xiaoxueji is gifted."
"Perhaps she is suitable for [Whispers of All Souls] and can tame beasts in the future."
Then, Xu Chuan looked at Xu Mingxian's message.
[Xu Mingxian: The second generation of the Xu family]
[Spiritual root: all five elements, can be practiced, mixed spiritual root qualifications]
[Talent: Swallowing Mountains and Rivers]
[Bloodline: None]
[Note: All practitioners have all five elements. Their qualifications are divided into false spiritual roots, miscellaneous spiritual roots, true spiritual roots, earth spiritual roots and heavenly spiritual roots. They are mainly divided according to the purity of the spiritual roots.
Swallowing Mountains and Rivers with Qi: Introducing Qi into the body, the speed of recovering mana will be several times faster than that of others. When used to the extreme, it can reach several times. It truly has the potential to swallow mountains and rivers with Qi.]
"Talent for cultivating immortals!"
Xu Chuan's face showed a look of ecstasy.
The Xu family finally gave birth to a person with the talent of cultivating immortals.
This means that the second generation is expected to be exposed to the world of immortal cultivators from the beginning.
At the same time, a large amount of content suddenly poured into Xu Chuan's mind, and when put together, it turned out to be a classic book from mortal to immortal.
It's called "Innate Five Elements Creation Power".
This is the first descendant born in the Xu family who is gifted in cultivating immortals, a technique given by the family tree.
Only those who have reached the innate realm of martial arts can practice.
It can make up for the deficiencies of the five elements, purify the spiritual roots, and finally reach the level of true spiritual roots.
